reason: Runtime v14 showed that 42 of 120 post-type mistakes occurred when both base reviews agreed, so disagreement-only consensus cannot reach the locked exact-set floor. This consumed-development probe rechecks every row in five-row batches, using the two already-saved v14 base reviews as fallible proposals and requiring source-verifiable quotes. It makes no new base-classification call and cannot approve release.

cohort.selection: fixed-seed 40 each en/zh-cn/ja from the consumed 500-row development cohort

prompt.source_envelope: candidate-blind source fields plus two saved v14 base-review proposals; no gold labels, strata, source roles, or source hints

decision_rule: Strictly validate every audit and every exact source quote. Continue to a production-path implementation and a full consumed-development assessment only if all 120 rows are valid, overall and each-locale exact post-type sets reach at least 0.70, exact product-label sets reach at least 0.85, outcome accuracy reaches at least 0.90, context_missing precision and recall each reach at least 0.50 when supported, and no supported job, event, opportunity, personnel, or Other F1 floor regresses below 0.55. A selected implementation must still pass a newly sampled zero-overlap final cohort under all unchanged floors.
global_stop: The transport reserves worst-case input, output, and dollar capacity before every attempt, refuses request 25 or attempt 49, and permits at most one repeat of a malformed five-row audit. Capacity cannot transfer to another lane, prompt, cohort, or provider. Any incomplete or invalid row blocks the probe.
